I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 16 August deadline, so I treated it as hearsay.

- **No record:** I couldn't find any Tamsin Cold Chain files that Pree could see, and nothing in #central-team mentions a deadline for their order form.
- **Date problem:** Today is 19 October 2026, so if they meant 16 August this year, that date has already passed. They may have meant next year, or it was misheard.
- **What I suggested:** Check with her Tamsin contact or look at the order form itself before anyone acts on it.
